_doc: Scatter sprites for the terrain scatter layer and border scatter (pebbles at rock / dirt, dead grass at grass / dirt, leaves, twigs). Placed per cell by the terrain shader.
avoid: background texture, soil, grass, shadows on the background, gradient background, text, watermark, cartoon

cells.prompt: Three small rounded grey and brown pebbles
A few small angular light grey rock chips
A single small dry brown dead leaf, curled at the edges
A small thin dry twig with one fork, grey-brown bark
A small loose handful of short dead dry grass bits, pale straw colour
A small cluster of brown pine needles and a tiny pine cone
